text:
maya: Quick poll — packing sneakers in a carry-on for offsite: what’s your go-to to keep them from grossing out your clothes? :sneakers: :thinking:

 tom: Shower cap + shoes inside. Cheap, weirdly effective. :ok_hand:

 eli: +1 shower cap. Also stick them in the bottom of a packing cube so they don’t smear everything.

 jen: I use a thin grocery bag then tuck it into the laundry shoe compartment of my backpack. keeps laces contained.

 sam: Shoe trees? jk. real tip: slip socks over soles so insoles don’t stick to clothes.

 maya: haha shoe trees on a plane would be extra. Anyone tried using a hotel pillowcase as a shoe bag?

 eli: Pillowcase works surprisingly well, hotel linens are usually clean. Also doubles as laundry bag on return.

 tom: Pro travel hack (tiny): put insoles or a dryer sheet inside each shoe to avoid funk. Smell stays away. :dash:

 jen: Quick packing checklist I use for quick offsites:
```
- shoes in shower-cap or pillowcase
- dryer sheet in shoes
- socks over soles
- pack cubes, shoes at bottom
- small shoe-first aid (band-aids)
```

 maya: Love the checklist. vote: shower cap vs pillowcase vs packing cube? react with :one:, :two:, :three:

 travel-bot: Poll created: 1) Shower cap 2) Pillowcase 3) Packing cube — ends in 24 hours.

 sam: I clicked :two: — if you’re short on space, pillowcase is multipurpose.

 eli: :three: for me, helps keep shape and compress other stuff around it.

 tom: Also FYI — if you can, wear the bulkiest shoes on the flight. saves space.

 jen: PSA for Europe offsite: some hostels still charge for laundry machines. always check before you assume free.

 maya: good call. anyone need an extra power adapter or battery bank for the trip? I have one spare international adapter (UK/EU/US)

 sam: I’ll take the adapter if still free — can swing by on Friday? :pray:

 maya: sure — will DM pick-up time.

 eli: tiny debate: compression socks on flights — necessary or theatrical?

 jen: necessary if you’re doing red-eyes and stood around a lot. airline doc suggested them once.

 sam: theatrical but also comfy. I bring ankle-high compression.

 maya: ok this thread unexpectedly turned into a full packing thread. thanks everyone! I’ll post results after poll closes. :v:
